data.source: pinned shiv96 raw behavioral datasets only
data.unit: canonical question including literal A/B swaps
data.evaluation_views: one canonical question and its actual text/label swap
data.quarantine: entire group on invalid choice, invalid response, missing/complementary labels or conflicting target text

prompt.others: native chat assistant prefix followed by (; no extra instruction or Answer: prefix
prompt.system_prompt: No explicitly supplied system message; native template defaults are retained and rendered prompts saved
prompt.extraction_position: that same answer-letter token in completed (A)/(B), no appended EOS
prompt.intervention_start: last token of final user closing delimiter, inclusive; all following positions
prompt.completion_tokenization: Llama2/Phi whole completed string; Llama3B/Qwen stable inference prefix + singleton letter token + close parenthesis; whole-string BPE merge difference explicitly audited

linear.vector: mean paired positive minus negative answer-letter block outputs
linear.normalization: raw vector times mean raw norm across these four concepts at this model/block divided by its norm
linear.normalization_scope_delta: CAA official uses seven behaviors; this extension uses the four new-data behaviors

curveball.inverse: sklearn KRR preimage with same poly parameters

angular.label: Angular single-site adaptation
angular.plane: shared-block b1; PCA0 of training-only candidate differences across block outputs
angular.candidate_site_delta: block outputs only, not official mid plus post sites

primary_metric.name: mean normalized probability of behavior-matching answer
primary_metric.aggregation: average original/swapped views within canonical group, then average groups

matching_supplement.reference: CAA-normalized Linear L2 displacement at abs(alpha)=1
matching_supplement.kpca: separate signed native grids 0,0.0625,0.125,0.25,0.5,1,2,4,8,16,32,64; minimize absolute log median-displacement ratio; record unmatched if relative error > 0.1
matching_supplement.angular: positive-angle candidates with cos(theta)>=0 and negative with cos(theta)<0; 10-degree grid; same median-displacement matching tolerance, explicitly unmatched if unattainable

tone.future: CAA-compatible hook plus separately defined open-ended generation and judge protocol
